messages:
Renee (People Ops): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A — posting the consolidated answers about promotions, contractor eligibility, and timing. Please ask any clarifying Qs here and we'll update the Notion FAQ.

Marta (Eng Manager): thx. first: are contractors eligible for promotions or title changes this cycle? we have a long-term contractor who's taken on IC2 work.

Hiro (Comp): contractors are not part of the salaried promotion cycle. For long-term contractors doing full-time scope, managers should open a hire/convert discussion instead of a promo packet. If conversion is approved, full promo/comp consideration happens after conversion.

Olivia (Contractor): fwiw it's rough — sounds like conversion is the only path. would a conversion backdated to before calibration be considered for comp/level?

Renee (People Ops): conversion effective dates are handled case-by-case. If conversion is approved before calibration closes and paperwork is in, we can include the person in the promo packet. Retro comp is only for admin error or board-approved exceptions.

Sam (IC2): any change to band adjustments for US vs APAC? heard market moves were US-focused.

Hiro (Comp): correct — this quarter is targeted US market adjustments. APAC/EMEA reviews are planned for later quarters. We'll publish band medians and quartiles in the comp FAQ next week so teams have visibility.

Marta (Eng Manager): manager checklist? can we get a compact one-pager to standardize packets across managers?

Renee (People Ops): yes — checklist (role summary, 3 impact bullets, metrics, peer feedback, current comp, target band) live now in Notion. I'll DM the Google packet template to all managers. Also posting an example anonymized packet to help formatting.

Sam (IC2): what about salary compression concerns when a junior gets a big market bump but senior ICs are stagnant?

Hiro (Comp): we watch compression and will flag edge cases during calibration. If you're worried about a specific team, managers should flag via the comp exception form and add context; Comp + People Ops will review before final approvals.

Marta (Eng Manager): timeline recap for the thread — manager submissions and calibration dates?

Renee (People Ops): manager packets due May 8 EOD PT. Calibration panels May 15-16. Final approvals by May 22. Appeals open for 14 days after your manager conversation; appeals reviewed by People Ops + 2 non-involved seniors + Comp rep, aiming for 10 business day turnaround.

hr-bot: Templates & FAQ uploaded: https://redwoodinference.notion.site/Promo-Conversion-FAQ-1782054321

Renee (People Ops): office hours (to accommodate APAC): Tue 8am PT and Thu 5pm PT — sign-up on Notion. DM Hiro + me for urgent exceptions. :raised_hands:
